metadata.description: design-expert: a paragraph-first, evidence-grounded skill for interface design. One command that plans, builds, reviews, iterates, and writes UI with the discipline of NNg heuristics, Universal Design, anti-AI-slop patterns, and a pantheon of designers convened as a council.

plugins.name: design-expert
plugins.description: One command that triages design work (plan, build, review, write, iterate), discovers the project's design system, picks the output surface (Figma, Claude Design canvas, or code), and ships with craft and evidence: NNg heuristics, Universal Design 7, anti-AI-slop patterns, and a seventeen-designer pantheon convened as a council.
